body:
Adds `research/multiclass-tangent-log`, the multiclass follow-up left open in `categorical-scores` and `tangent-log`.

- Bounded strictly proper K-class log score via quadratic tangent extension of `x ln x`
- Payment range exactly `1 - ln eps`, independent of K
- Rare-class incentive per range vs Brier, best cutoff eps = p_min
- Closed-form cost of dropping a rare class
- 7 tests, experiments, white paper; portfolio page and README updated
